description: Reads Bitbucket Cloud workspace, repository, pull request, issue, commit, pipeline, deployment, snippet, and project resources; declares typed reverse-ETL actions for documented mutations with destructive confirmation on deletes.
name: bitbucket

risk.approval: Reverse ETL writes require plan, preview, explicit approval, and typed destructive confirmation for destructive actions.
risk.read: Read-only Bitbucket Cloud REST calls against configured workspaces, repositories, or typed resource identifiers.
risk.write: Typed Bitbucket Cloud mutations only; DELETE actions carry destructive confirmation and all writes use reverse-ETL plan, preview, approval, execute.
